[[File:Droid_Prisoner_Compartment_drawing.jpg|thumb|right|250px|An [[Astromech droid/Legends|Astromech droid]] in an opened Droid Prisoner Compartment]]
The '''Droid Prisoner Compartment''' was a module contained at the back of each [[Reconnaissance Troop Transporter]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was used for the detention and taming of rebellious [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="Toy 1">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars (Kenner toy line)|pack=Imperial Troop Transporter|link=vintTroopTransport.asp}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Imperial troop transporter (story booklet)|''Imperial troop transporter'']] comic book that came packaged with [[Kenner Products|Kenner's]] [[1979]] Imperial Troop Transporter toy also refers to this compartment in one instance as a [[Prisoner Immobilization Unit]], which is actually a different device identified in the toy's instruction manual and on its box. The correct name is used later in the story.<ref name="ITT comic">[[Imperial troop transporter (story booklet)|Imperial troop transporter story booklet]]</ref>

The manual and packaging of the slightly modified and renamed "Imperial Cruiser" toy from Kenner's [[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (toy line)|''The Empire Strikes Back'' toy line]] only refer to this as a "compartment" and show it being used for a human action figure.<ref name="Toy 2">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (toy line)|pack=Imperial Cruiser|altlink=http://theswca.com/images-toys/figuretoys/impcruiser.html}}</ref>
